scope: All 155 residual whole-token tedy occurrences in Book 44 after the conditional and equivalence tranches.
choice: Render 151 ordinary conclusions as zato, one explicit equivalence as to jest, and three causal-collision contexts with a tym samym/tym samym recast.
motivation: Every Book occurrence was classified against German and clause syntax. No temporal use remains; collision-aware recasts avoid malformed zato...zato že sequences.
alternatives_rejected: Blanket zato would create three causal collisions and misrender one equivalence.
Togda would invent temporal event ordering; the audited temporal category is empty.
Retaining tedy preserves a West-only connective layer despite exact semantic resolution.

evidence.german_controls: Exact controls distinguish ordinary also/mithin/folglich, one group-order/exponent equivalence, and three also-da collision clauses.
evidence.ordinal_review: Every one of 155 pre-edit Book matches was selected exactly once, including four separately classified tokens on line 2836.

validation.postcondition: Book, paper45 and bibliography have zero tedy/teda; base alone retains 251 pending classified sites
validation.structure: TeX controls, labels/refs/cites, braces, math delimiters and line counts invariant
validation.reproducibility: frozen successor hashes reproduced before atomic apply
